title: QA_Platform_buyer_opens_messages_list_on_live_event
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As the event's buyer, open the Messages list grouped by thread (GET /v1/chats?module=EventGroup&module_uuid={{eventGroupUuid}}&group_by=thread_id).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty list [] (no thread exists on a fresh event).
rationale: First call of the Messages drawer; a failure hides every vendor query from the buyer.

title: QA_Platform_invited_vendor_opens_messages_list
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As QA vendor 1, open the event's Messages list grouped by thread.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with [] — the invited vendor passes the event visibility check and sees only threads it takes part in (none yet).
rationale: Vendors raise and read clarifications here; an invited vendor must be let in.

title: QA_Platform_messages_list_reached_through_round_id
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As the buyer, open the Messages list passing the RFQ round instead of the event (module=TradeRequest).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with [] — resolve_module_params rewrites the round to its event before the list runs.
rationale: The bids header still sends module=TradeRequest; a break empties the drawer on those screens.

title: QA_Platform_unknown_round_as_trade_request_module_crashes
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Open the Messages list with module=TradeRequest and a round id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today the before-action resolve_module_params calls nil.event_group_id after TradeRequest.find_by_id returns nil (chats_controller.rb:427-429) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 533 'Project does not exist.'.
rationale: The translation runs before every v1 chats action, so a stale round id breaks the list, counts, pickers and create.

title: QA_Platform_messages_list_without_event_id_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Open the Messages list with module=EventGroup and no event id.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters' (no branch sets the context, chats_controller.rb:33).
rationale: A screen that lost its event id must get a clear bad-request answer.

title: QA_Platform_messages_list_unknown_event_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Open the Messages list for an event id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 533 'Project does not exist.' — the list checks the event exists before the permission check.
rationale: Guards the existence check that the count and picker actions lack.

title: QA_Platform_messages_list_on_draft_event_refused
preconditions: A draft event with one unpublished RFQ round, owned by the run's buyer. The request only reads or is refused before anything is saved.
steps: 1. As the owner, open the Messages list of the draft event.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 533 'Project does not exist.' — only live and withdrawn events are looked up (VALID_STATUSES_FOR_DASHBOARD).
rationale: The screen hides Messages on drafts; the API must refuse cleanly, not crash.

title: QA_Platform_malformed_filter_on_thread_view_crashes
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As the buyer, open the thread view of the Messages list with a filter that is not JSON.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today CommonFunctions.parse_filters swallows the JSON error and returns nil, then the thread view reads @filters["thread_id"] on nil (chats_controller.rb:57) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 200 [] ignoring the filter, or 422 code 2.
rationale: A bad deep link or hand-edited URL takes the drawer down.

title: QA_Platform_buyer_reads_messages_counts_on_live_event
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As the buyer, read the Messages counts for the event.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with total_threads_count 0 and unresolved_threads_count null (no thread with an active assignment).
rationale: The Messages button polls this every 30 s on every event page.

title: QA_Platform_owner_reads_messages_counts_on_draft
preconditions: A draft event with one unpublished RFQ round, owned by the run's buyer. The request only reads or is refused before anything is saved.
steps: 1. As the owner, read the Messages counts of the draft event.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with total_threads_count 0 — the count deliberately accepts draft events (VALID_STATUSES_FOR_DASHBOARD + [:draft]) and the owner passes the draft visibility rule.
rationale: Unlike every other read here, drafts are allowed; the owner must get zeros, not an error.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_cannot_read_counts_of_draft_event
preconditions: A draft event with one unpublished RFQ round, owned by the run's buyer. The request only reads or is refused before anything is saved.
steps: 1. As QA vendor 1, read the Messages counts of the buyer's draft event.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 455 'You are not authorized to perform this action' — a draft has no stages a vendor may view, so EventGroupPolicy#show? is false.
rationale: The count accepts drafts, so the permission check alone keeps vendors from probing unpublished events.

title: QA_Platform_counts_for_unknown_event_crash
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Read the Messages counts for an event id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today authorize(nil, :show?) raises Pundit::NotDefinedError, which is not rescued (chats_controller.rb:203-204) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 533 as the list answers.
rationale: Missing existence check before the permission check.

title: QA_Platform_query_on_unknown_event_crashes_before_save
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist. Nothing can be created: the error is raised before the transaction.
steps: 1. Raise a general query on an event id that does not exist, without naming recipients (the vendor-side shape).
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today @event_group is nil and line 109 calls nil.company_id → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 533. No chat is created.
rationale: The event is used without a nil check on the create path.

title: QA_Platform_query_on_unknown_event_with_recipient_crashes
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist. Nothing can be created: the error is raised before the transaction.
steps: 1. Raise a general query on an event id that does not exist, naming QA vendor 1 as recipient (the buyer-side shape).
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today line 109 is skipped and authorize(nil, :show?) raises Pundit::NotDefinedError (chats_controller.rb:110) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 533.
rationale: Only Pundit::NotAuthorizedError is rescued; authorize on nil is an untyped 500.

title: QA_Platform_query_without_module_crashes
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer. Nothing can be created: the first statement in the transaction raises before Chat.create!.
steps: 1. Raise a general query without module or event id.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today no module branch runs and line 128 calls nil.user_id inside the transaction, before any create → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 2 'Insufficient parameters'.
rationale: Missing-parameter requests should be refused up front.

title: QA_Platform_query_on_draft_event_crashes
preconditions: A draft event with one unpublished RFQ round, owned by the run's buyer. The request only reads or is refused before anything is saved.
steps: 1. As the owner, raise a general query on the draft event.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today drafts are excluded by the status filter, so @event_group is nil and line 109 calls nil.company_id → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 533. Nothing is created.
rationale: A draft id behaves like an unknown event on create.

title: QA_Platform_query_on_unknown_purchase_request_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Raise a general query on a purchase request id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 812 'Purchase Request not found'. Nothing is created.
rationale: The purchase-request branch of the same endpoint refuses cleanly; regression guard.

title: QA_Platform_unknown_query_context_with_line_item_crashes
preconditions: A published RFQ with one line item. Safe: the error is raised while building the chat title, before Chat.create! (chats_controller_helper.rb:207 runs before chats_controller_helper.rb:65).
steps: 1. As the buyer, raise a query whose 'regarding' value is not general/technical/commercial, on the event's line item.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today get_chat_title leaves title nil and T.must(nil) raises TypeError (chats_controller_helper.rb:202-207) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 2.
rationale: Unknown context values are never validated.

title: QA_Platform_query_without_context_or_line_item_not_refused
preconditions: A published RFQ. Safe: with no context and no line items the create loop runs zero times, so no chat is created and nobody is notified.
steps: 1. As the buyer, send a query with a message but no 'regarding' value and no line items.
expectedResult: Should be refused: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters'. Today nothing is created and the reply is either HTTP 200 'null' or HTTP 500 from serialising a nil chat (chats_controller.rb:145-156) — both are the defect.
rationale: The screen would report 'Message posted successfully!' for a query that was never saved.

title: QA_Platform_query_attachments_as_text_crash
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist. An unknown purchase request is used so that, even if attachments were parsed, the request would stop at 812 — nothing can be created.
steps: 1. Raise a general query whose attachments field is a plain text instead of a list.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today "…".map raises NoMethodError at chats_controller.rb:103, before any lookup → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 2 (or 812).
rationale: Attachments are mapped before any validation.

title: QA_Platform_query_attachment_without_file_link_crashes
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist. Unknown purchase request, as above — nothing can be created.
steps: 1. Raise a general query with one attachment whose file entry has a name but no private_url.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today AttachmentValue.new(name:) raises ArgumentError for the missing private_url keyword (attachment.rb:15, attachment_value.rb:15) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 2.
rationale: Required attachment keys are enforced by Ruby keyword arguments, not by validation.

title: QA_Platform_open_unknown_chat_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Open a chat id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters' (the code this action uses for 'chat not found').
rationale: Stale e-mail deep links must get a clean refusal.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_reply_to_unknown_chat_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. As QA vendor 1, reply to a chat id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters'. Nothing is saved and nobody is notified (the lookup at line 166-167 returns first).
rationale: The reply box may hold a chat id from an earlier screen.

title: QA_Platform_reply_attachments_as_text_crash
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Reply to a chat id that does not exist with attachments sent as plain text.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today "…".map raises NoMethodError at chats_controller.rb:163, before the chat is even looked up → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 2.
rationale: Same unguarded attachment mapping as create, running first.

title: QA_Platform_resolve_unknown_thread_refused
preconditions: QA vendor 1 signed in; the thread id is invented and matches no chat.
steps: 1. As QA vendor 1, mark an unknown thread as resolved.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 475 'Chat not found'. Nothing is closed.
rationale: Stale 'Mark as Resolve' clicks must be refused clearly.

title: QA_Platform_reassign_unknown_thread_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer; the thread id is invented.
steps: 1. Reassign an unknown thread.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 475 'Chat not found'. Nothing is assigned, nobody notified.
rationale: Guard on the assign action.

title: QA_Platform_assignee_options_unknown_thread_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer; the thread id is invented.
steps: 1. Load the assignee options for an unknown thread.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 475 'Chat not found'.
rationale: The assignee picker loads lazily and must not crash on a stale thread.

title: QA_Platform_close_unknown_single_chat_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Close a single chat id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 475 'Chat not found'.
rationale: Guard on the per-chat close action.

title: QA_Platform_buyer_vendor_picker_lists_invited_vendors
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As the buyer, load the 'Select vendor(s)' options of the New Message form.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with a list of {uuid, name, vendor_code, location}; QA vendor 1 is listed when its relationship status is one of the company's allowed vendor statuses.
rationale: Without this list the buyer cannot address any vendor.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_picker_on_draft_event_crashes
preconditions: A draft event with one unpublished RFQ round, owned by the run's buyer. The request only reads or is refused before anything is saved.
steps: 1. As the owner, load the vendor picker of the draft event.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today drafts are filtered out, eg is nil and authorize(nil, :show?) raises Pundit::NotDefinedError (chats_controller.rb:243-244) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 533.
rationale: No existence check before authorize.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_picker_without_event_id_crashes
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer.
steps: 1. Load the vendor picker with module=EventGroup and no event id.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today no branch sets possible_participants and line 261 calls nil.map → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 2.
rationale: Missing id is not checked in this action.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_picker_unknown_onboarding_response_crashes
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Load the vendor picker for a vendor-onboarding response id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today FxResponse.active.find_by_id returns nil and nil.fetch_vendor_details raises (chats_controller.rb:253-254) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422.
rationale: No nil check (and no permission check) on the FxResponse branch.

title: QA_Platform_buyer_line_item_picker_lists_event_line_items
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads. The event has one line item.
steps: 1. As the buyer, load the 'Select line item(s)' options.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with one option {label '1. | <code> | <name>', value, info, assignee_uuid} (assignee empty because no context is sent).
rationale: Technical and commercial queries must name line items.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_line_item_picker_opens
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As QA vendor 1, load the line-item options of the event.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with the event's line item.
rationale: Vendors raise line-item queries too.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_cannot_list_line_items_of_draft
preconditions: A draft event with one unpublished RFQ round, owned by the run's buyer. The request only reads or is refused before anything is saved.
steps: 1. As QA vendor 1, load the line-item options of the buyer's draft event.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 455 'You are not authorized to perform this action' — this picker has no status filter, so the draft is found and the permission check refuses.
rationale: The permission check alone keeps draft contents away from vendors here.

title: QA_Platform_line_item_picker_unknown_event_crashes
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Load the line-item options for an event id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today authorize(nil, :show?) raises Pundit::NotDefinedError (chats_controller.rb:297-298) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 533.
rationale: No existence check before authorize.

title: QA_Platform_line_item_picker_unsupported_module_crashes
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Load the line-item options with module=FxResponse.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today only EventGroup and PurchaseRequest set eglis, so line 305 calls nil.map → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 2 or an empty list.
rationale: Unsupported module names are not refused.

title: QA_Platform_line_item_picker_without_event_id_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer.
steps: 1. Load the line-item options with module=EventGroup and no event id.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters'.
rationale: This action checks for a missing id first; regression guard.

title: QA_Platform_buyer_thread_filter_options
preconditions: A published RFQ with QA vendor 1 invited, bidding open, no queries raised yet. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As the buyer, load the thread-list filter options.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with data = four filters: reference_uuids (Line Item), company_uuids (Vendor), resolution_status (Closed/Open), title (General/Technical/Commercial).
rationale: The filter bar of the Messages drawer is built from this.

title: QA_Platform_filter_options_unknown_event_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Load filter options for an event id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 533 'Project does not exist.'.
rationale: Clean counterpart of the crashing count/picker actions.

title: QA_Platform_filter_options_without_event_id_crash
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer.
steps: 1. Load filter options with module=EventGroup and no event id.
expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today eg stays nil and is passed to get_chat_filter_options, typed EventGroup, then dereferenced (chats_controller_helper.rb:401-405) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 2.
rationale: Missing id is not checked in this action.

title: QA_Platform_filter_options_on_draft_refused
preconditions: A draft event with one unpublished RFQ round, owned by the run's buyer. The request only reads or is refused before anything is saved.
steps: 1. As the owner, load filter options of the draft event.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 533 'Project does not exist.' (drafts are excluded by status).
rationale: Drafts must be refused cleanly.

title: QA_Platform_buyer_reads_per_vendor_unresolved_counts
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 has submitted a bid; no queries. The request only reads.
steps: 1. As the buyer, read the per-vendor unresolved query counts for the RFQ round (as the comparison sheet does).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with {} — no bidding vendor has an open query.
rationale: Feeds the per-vendor message badge on the comparison sheet.

title: QA_Platform_per_vendor_counts_unknown_round_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Read per-vendor unresolved counts for a round id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action'.
rationale: The round id is the only input.

title: QA_Platform_list_personal_chats
preconditions: The run's buyer, signed in. Read only.
steps: 1. Open the personal (one-to-one) chat inbox.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with total_unread_chats and a chats list (possibly empty).
rationale: The older chat inbox must open for any signed-in user.

title: QA_Platform_open_unknown_personal_chat_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Open a personal chat id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 475 'Chat not found'.
rationale: Clean refusal for a stale link.

title: QA_Platform_messages_of_unknown_personal_chat_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Load the messages of a personal chat id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 15 'Operation failed'.
rationale: The conversation call answers 'not found' with its own code.

title: QA_Platform_send_into_personal_chat_not_a_participant_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in user; no event needed. The id Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to 999999999, which does not exist.
steps: 1. Send a message into a personal chat the user is not part of (an id that does not exist).
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 4 'Request not found'. Nothing is saved (the participant check at line 95-96 returns first).
rationale: The participant check is the only barrier to writing into someone else's chat.

title: QA_Platform_start_personal_chat_with_unknown_user_refused
preconditions: Any signed-in buyer. User id 999999999 does not exist, so the 'may these users talk' check refuses before any chat is created.
steps: 1. Ask for the personal chat with a user id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Refused: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action'. No chat is created.
rationale: This GET creates a chat on first call; the refusal must come before that.
